why: COMFY-STYLE-05 провалил визуальную приёмку: на SDXL-Turbo при CFG 2.0 LoRA Fictiverse не влияет, RAL даёт игрушечный вид. Здесь тот же стилевой блок проверяется на обычном SDXL Base 1.0 при CFG 5–7 и 25–30 шагах.

style_module.license: openrail — коммерческое использование требует отдельной проверки
style_module.ral_policy: RAL LoRA (ral-vxl) в этом этапе и в производственном контуре НЕ применяется (FACT-D21)

resolution.note: 1024x1024 не проверяется: на 8 ГБ VRAM при занятых ~1.5 ГБ сторонними приложениями не влезает

diagnostic_prompt.positive: voxel style, blocky 3D orc warrior, full body, neutral A-pose, pixel textures, plain studio background
diagnostic_prompt.negative: character sheet, turnaround, multiple views, multiple characters, two characters, collage, cropped head, cropped feet, weapon, text, watermark
diagnostic_prompt.why: короткий промпт для проверки связности и утечки нескольких фигур; без длинных списков

character_prompt.head_face: heavy protruding lower jaw, two large lower tusks, deep brow ridge, flat broad nose
character_prompt.clothing_armor: rough leather tunic, iron-studded left shoulder plate, simple bracers
character_prompt.palette: muted green-grey skin, brown leather, dark iron
character_prompt.pose: neutral A-pose with arms slightly away from the body
character_prompt.camera: three-quarter front view, full body from head to feet
character_prompt.background: plain neutral studio background, soft even lighting

blocks.BODY_STYLE_LOCK: block-built voxel 3D body, cubes of varied sizes (large blocks for the silhouette, medium blocks for anatomy and clothing, small blocks for details), hard-edged planar surfaces, pixel-textured materials over the whole body, chunky readable humanoid proportions, separate readable arms and legs, separated hands and feet, modular body parts
blocks.FACE_STYLE_LOCK: fully voxel face geometry, skull, brow ridge, cheekbones, nose, jaw and chin built from blocks of different sizes, pixel-textured face consistent with the body materials, adult facial proportions, visible eyes with solid block pupils (not oversized), defined nose bridge, readable mouth, face readable when the model is scaled down to game size
blocks.COMPOSITION: single character only, one figure, full body from head to feet, neutral A-pose, three-quarter front view, plain neutral studio background, soft even lighting, no props, no weapon, nothing cropped
blocks.NEGATIVE: character sheet, turnaround, multiple views, multiple characters, two characters, three characters, collage, split image, repeated figures, duplicate, chibi, childlike proportions, oversized eyes, tiny nose, doll face, anime proportions, smooth rounded face, organic realistic skin, plastic cartoon, painterly, primitive face made of a few pixels, caricature, flat 2d pixel art sprite, fused limbs, extra limbs, deformed hands, missing fingers, cropped head, cropped feet, realistic photo, photorealistic, weapon, sword, axe, helmet covering the face, cluttered background, motion blur, extreme perspective, watermark, text, signature

prompt_long_template: voxel style, {BODY_STYLE_LOCK}, {FACE_STYLE_LOCK}, {race_species}, {body_type}, face: {head_face}, clothing and armor: {clothing_armor}, palette: {palette}, {pose}, {camera}, {COMPOSITION}
